name: Third party portal excel format
query:
SELECT 
    po.name AS "PO Number:Link/Purchase Order:150",
    po.supplier AS "Supplier:Link/Supplier:150",
    poi.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
    poi.item_name AS "Item Name::200",
    poi.qty AS "Ordered Qty:Float:100",
    poi.received_qty AS "Received Qty:Float:100",
    (poi.qty - poi.received_qty) AS "Pending Qty:Float:100",
    poi.schedule_date AS "Expected Delivery Date:Date:120",
    po.status AS "PO Status::100",
    po.transaction_date AS "PO Date:Date:100",
    po.company AS "Company:Link/Company:150"
FROM 
    `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
JOIN 
    `tabPurchase Order` po ON poi.parent = po.name
WHERE 
    po.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')
ORDER BY 
    po.transaction_date DESC;
